# uptimekuma_notification_halopsa (Resource)

HaloPSA notification resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uptimekuma_notification_halopsa" "example" {
  name        = "HaloPSA Notifications"
  webhook_url = "https://halopsa.example.com/webhook/YOUR_TOKEN"
  username    = "your-username"
  password    = "your-password"
  is_default  = false
}

# Requires Terraform or OpenTofu 1.11 or later: webhook_url_wo and password_wo are
# never stored in plan or state. Change the matching *_wo_version whenever a
# secret changes.
resource "uptimekuma_notification_halopsa" "write_only" {
  name     = "HaloPSA with write-only secrets"
  username = "your-username"

  webhook_url_wo         = "https://halopsa.example.com/webhook/YOUR_TOKEN"
  webhook_url_wo_version = "1"
  password_wo            = "your-password"
  password_wo_version    = "1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Notification name
- `username` (String) The username for HaloPSA authentication.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `apply_existing` (Boolean)
- `is_default` (Boolean)
- `password` (String, Sensitive) The password for HaloPSA authentication. Stored in state; use `password_wo` to keep it out of state.
- `password_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) The password for HaloPSA authentication, write-only: sent to Uptime Kuma on create and update but never stored in plan or state. Requires Terraform 1.11 or OpenTofu 1.11 or later. Conflicts with `password`; requires `password_wo_version`. An imported resource has no `password_wo_version` yet, so `terraform import` may store the server's value in `password` until the next apply with `password_wo` set removes it from state.
- `password_wo_version` (String) Any value that changes whenever `password_wo` changes, for example a counter or a hash of the secret's encrypted source. A change triggers an update that sends the current `password_wo`.
- `webhook_url` (String, Sensitive) The HaloPSA webhook URL to which notifications will be sent. Stored in state; use `webhook_url_wo` to keep it out of state.
- `webhook_url_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) The HaloPSA webhook URL to which notifications will be sent, write-only: sent to Uptime Kuma on create and update but never stored in plan or state. Requires Terraform 1.11 or OpenTofu 1.11 or later. Conflicts with `webhook_url`; requires `webhook_url_wo_version`. An imported resource has no `webhook_url_wo_version` yet, so `terraform import` may store the server's value in `webhook_url` until the next apply with `webhook_url_wo` set removes it from state.
- `webhook_url_wo_version` (String) Any value that changes whenever `webhook_url_wo` changes, for example a counter or a hash of the secret's encrypted source. A change triggers an update that sends the current `webhook_url_wo`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Notification identifier
